scope: Supplementary-table matches for two additional cancer–embryonic program catalogs. These proposals are separate from the 15 nomination papers used in release 1.31.0.

catalogs.title: DUX4 Suppresses MHC Class I to Promote Cancer Immune Evasion and Resistance to Checkpoint Blockade
catalogs.model: DUX4-induced gene program evaluated in human cancers; target definition also used induced myoblast experiments.
catalogs.note: PRAMEF25 matches the historical WI2-2994D6.2 entry by Ensembl ID and is one member of the shared PRAMEF25/6 protein. DUXB matches by symbol; its source Gene ID is also DUXB. The paper reports DUXB expression in healthy tissues.
catalogs.interpretation: Add as a cancer–embryonic program catalog, preserving each gene’s normal-expression findings.

screen_table.interpretation: Table S1 is the full cancer-specificity scoring table. Its 74 matches are measured genes, not 74 CTA nominations.

catalogs.title: DUX4 expression in cancer induces a metastable early embryonic totipotent program
catalogs.catalog: Table S3A: zygotic gene activation and eight-cell-like gene sets
catalogs.model: Single-cell RNA sequencing of KLE and SUSA cancer cell lines using published zygotic gene activation and eight-cell-like gene sets.
catalogs.note: Exact gene-symbol matches to the 122. Membership records the program evaluated in cancer cells; gene-level measurements and effect sizes need separate extraction. MBD3L2 is not substituted for MBD3L2B, and H3Y is not mapped to H3Y1 in this count.
catalogs.interpretation: Add as an early-embryo program evaluated in cancer, with the original gene-set source retained.

gene_set_source.title: 8C-like cells capture the human zygotic genome activation program in vitro
